$comment: P1-T03 - the single source of truth for the C ABI between OpenMCAD and the geometry kernel.
tools/idlgen turns this file into five artefacts (see docs/specs/kernel-shim.md):
Only operation BODIES are hand-written. ADR-0003: this is the difference between a
maintainable 300-operation surface and a clerical nightmare.
- Append operations; do not reorder or rename shipped ones. The C ABI is a compatibility
surface once anything links against it.
- Every operation returns int32_t OpenMcadStatus. There is no other return channel.
- No pointers to kernel-owned memory ever cross. Bulk data uses the two-call pattern:
pass a null buffer to learn the required size, then call again with one that size.
- Mark fragile operations so the generator threads the retry ladder through them.

operations.name: initialize
operations.summary: Initialises the shim. Must be called once per process before any other entry point. Installs the OCCT signal handler so a floating-point fault inside the kernel becomes a catchable failure rather than a process death.

operations.name: shutdown
operations.summary: Releases process-wide shim resources. Optional; provided so leak detection has a clean baseline.

operations.name: version
operations.summary: Returns the shim and kernel version as UTF-8.

operations.name: shape_release
operations.summary: Drops one reference to a shape. The shape and all its sub-entities become invalid when the last reference goes.

operations.name: shape_add_ref
operations.summary: Takes an additional reference to a shape.

operations.name: history_release
operations.summary: Releases a history map.

operations.name: mesh_release
operations.summary: Releases a tessellation.

operations.name: last_error
operations.summary: Returns a description of the most recent failure on the calling thread.

operations.name: diagnostic_count
operations.summary: Returns how many diagnostics the last operation produced.

operations.name: diagnostic_severity
operations.summary: Returns one diagnostic severity.

operations.name: diagnostic_code
operations.summary: Returns one diagnostic stable code.

operations.name: diagnostic_message
operations.summary: Returns one diagnostic user-facing message.

operations.name: diagnostic_entities
operations.summary: Returns the entities one diagnostic refers to.

operations.name: diagnostics_clear
operations.summary: Discards the diagnostics from the last operation.

operations.name: create_box
operations.summary: Creates a box with its minimum corner at the placement origin.

parameters.name: size_x
parameters.summary: Extent along local X, in metres.

parameters.name: size_y
parameters.summary: Extent along local Y, in metres.

parameters.name: size_z
parameters.summary: Extent along local Z, in metres.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

operations.name: create_cylinder
operations.summary: Creates a cylinder about the local Z axis.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

operations.name: create_sphere
operations.summary: Creates a sphere centred on the placement origin.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

operations.name: create_cone
operations.summary: Creates a cone or truncated cone about the local Z axis.

parameters.name: bottom_radius
parameters.summary: Radius at the base, in metres.

parameters.name: top_radius
parameters.summary: Radius at the top, in metres.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

operations.name: create_torus
operations.summary: Creates a torus about the local Z axis.

parameters.name: major_radius
parameters.summary: Distance from the axis to the tube centre.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

operations.name: create_polygon_profile
operations.summary: Creates a closed planar profile from an outline.

parameters.name: points
parameters.summary: The outline in the frame XY plane, without a repeated closing point.

parameters.name: frame
parameters.summary: Maps the profile plane into the world.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

operations.name: extrude
operations.summary: Sweeps a profile along a straight path.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.summary: How far to sweep, in metres.

parameters.name: capped
parameters.summary: Whether to cap the ends, producing a solid.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

operations.name: revolve
operations.summary: Sweeps a profile about an axis.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.summary: How far to revolve, in radians.

parameters.name: capped
parameters.summary: Whether to cap the ends of a partial revolution.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

operations.name: boolean
operations.summary: Combines bodies.

parameters.name: tools
parameters.summary: The bodies being combined with it.

parameters.name: fuzzy_tolerance
parameters.summary: Relaxed tolerance for rung 3, or zero for none.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

parameters.name: rung
parameters.summary: Which rung of the retry ladder produced the result.

operations.name: fillet
operations.summary: Rounds edges.

parameters.name: radii
parameters.summary: One radius per edge, in metres.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

parameters.name: rung
parameters.summary: Which rung of the retry ladder produced the result.

operations.name: chamfer
operations.summary: Bevels edges.

parameters.name: distances
parameters.summary: One setback distance per edge, in metres.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

parameters.name: rung
parameters.summary: Which rung of the retry ladder produced the result.

operations.name: mass_properties
operations.summary: Computes volume, area, centroid, and inertia.

parameters.name: density
parameters.summary: Density in kilograms per cubic metre.

parameters.name: values
parameters.summary: Eleven doubles: volume, area, centroid xyz, then Ixx Iyy Izz Ixy Ixz Iyz.

operations.name: bounding_box
operations.summary: Computes the axis-aligned bound.

parameters.name: values
parameters.summary: Six doubles: min xyz then max xyz.

operations.name: topology_counts
operations.summary: Counts topological entities.

parameters.name: values
parameters.summary: Six counts: solids, shells, faces, wires, edges, vertices.

operations.name: enumerate
operations.summary: Lists entities of one kind in canonical order.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.summary: The entity tags, in canonical order.

operations.name: entity_kind
operations.summary: Returns what kind of entity a tag refers to.

operations.name: check_validity
operations.summary: Checks a shape for structural validity.

parameters.name: is_valid
parameters.summary: Non-zero when the shape is sound.

parameters.name: is_closed
parameters.summary: Non-zero when its shells are closed.

operations.name: triangulate
operations.summary: Triangulates a shape, returning a mesh handle.

parameters.name: chordal_deviation
parameters.summary: Maximum deviation from the true surface, in metres.

parameters.name: angular_deviation
parameters.summary: Maximum angle between adjacent facet normals, in radians.

parameters.name: relative
parameters.summary: Whether the chordal deviation is relative to shape size.

operations.name: mesh_counts
operations.summary: Returns a mesh size, so buffers can be allocated once.

operations.name: mesh_positions
operations.summary: Returns vertex positions as XYZ triples in metres.

operations.name: mesh_normals
operations.summary: Returns per-vertex normals as XYZ triples.

parameters.name: values
parameters.summary: Three doubles per vertex, empty if not computed.

operations.name: mesh_indices
operations.summary: Returns triangle vertex indices, three per triangle.

operations.name: mesh_triangle_faces
operations.summary: Returns the face index each triangle came from.

operations.name: mesh_faces
operations.summary: Returns the face tags the triangle attribution indexes into.

operations.name: write_brep
operations.summary: Writes a shape to the kernel native format.

operations.name: read_brep
operations.summary: Reads a shape written by write_brep.

parameters.name: history
parameters.summary: The correspondence between the inputs and the result.

operations.name: write_step
operations.summary: Writes shapes as a STEP AP242 file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.summary: Where to write. The OCCT writer wants a path, not a stream.

operations.name: history_generated
operations.summary: Returns the entities an input caused to come into existence.

operations.name: history_modified
operations.summary: Returns the altered successors of an input.

operations.name: history_is_deleted
operations.summary: Returns whether an input has no successor.

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.summary: Non-zero when the entity was consumed.

operations.name: history_new_entities
operations.summary: Returns the entities created from nothing.

operations.name: history_role_of
operations.summary: Returns what an output entity is, in the terms of the operation that made it.

parameters.name: role
parameters.summary: The OperationRole. Zero means unassigned, which is a defect.

operations.name: history_source_of
operations.summary: Returns the input an output came from.

parameters.name: source
parameters.summary: The source entity tag, or zero for entities created from nothing.

operations.name: history_outputs
operations.summary: Returns every output the map describes.

operations.name: history_inputs
operations.summary: Returns every input the map describes.
